text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is seeking authority to prohibit vehicles greater than two metres in width from travelling the lane north of Dundas Street West, west of Montrose Avenue. Prohibiting vehicles which have a width of two metres or more from travelling on the subject lane section would be beneficial in reducing the incidence of damage to the adjacent private property.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Prohibited vehicles over two metres in width from travelling on first lane north of Dundas Street West, between Crawford Street and Montrose Avenue.
